sql: SELECT r.pmcid, regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*40[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5419667' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%40%' LIMIT 5
rows: Inhibition of cholesteryl ester transfer protein by anacetrapib reduces low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol by around 25% to 40% and more than doubles high-density lipoprotein (HDL) cholesterol
